text.tspan: $ depaudit
depaudit 0.1.0
node_modules/analytics-helper/package.json
HIGH Dependency runs a script at install time install-hook
package: analytics-helper
Install hooks (postinstall) run automatically on `npm install`, before any code is
imported. This is the usual way malicious packages execute. Review what this script
does and whether you trust this dependency.
package.json
HIGH Dependency name looks like a typo of a popular package typosquat
package: reqeust
'reqeust' is one character away from 'request', a very popular package.
Typosquatting packages use near-identical names to get installed by mistake. Confirm
this is the package you meant.
MEDIUM Dependency pulled from outside the registry non-registry-source
package: internal-tools
'internal-tools' is installed from git+http://git.internal.example.com/tools.git,
not the npm registry, so it is not reviewed, versioned or integrity-checked like a
published package. Whoever controls that source controls the code.
